name: Note Lock (Casual Privacy)
description: A client-side password screen for casual privacy with optional navigation and search/feed filtering; not encryption or secure access control.
author: Kolten Bendickson

settings.name: Show file browser while locked
settings.description: Keep existing navigation usable so visitors can leave a locked homepage. Off keeps the full-page lock. Honors Digital Garden's file-browser setting; it does not protect other notes.

settings.name: Shared password for selected notes
settings.description: Set this once, then add a checkbox property named lock to each note you want to protect and check it. No URL mapping is needed. Passwords are visible in the garden source; use a unique passphrase.

settings.name: Different passwords by URL (advanced, optional)
settings.description: Leave {} for the checkbox workflow. For different passwords, copy the exact published path: {"/private-note/":"different passphrase"}. Invalid entries are ignored with build warnings; paths are never guessed. Only an exact / targets the homepage. Keep the source repository private.
